job_spec.purpose: Round 7: fcbc-r6 TT -80 (pd40) / -92 (pd45): N boundary fixed (k0_d output slack +77 / +56); remaining 974 / 826 viol D pins = u_ring rd_out (516 ps macro access) -> group select -> oq*, the bulk copy's DESIGNED two-cycle ring read (RING_MACRO=1) timed as one cycle because the fc_bc SDC lacked front_c's ring multicycle -> added (set_multicycle_path -setup 2 / -hold 1 -from *u_ring). FF: pd40 fo_row3 output hold -6.5 (registered face), pd45 +6.2. Round 6 (structural, physical spec el1011-hbm-smh.log 10-11 round 6): fc_is INT8 adapter + ob queue + bypass mux re-cut as 34 slices x 32 bits with kept per-slice control and fmt3 copies, high half held classified (cal3 TT -227: pending -> 512-bit codes mux -> classify -> 1088 a_data mux, 7-BUFx2 chain; class 2+5); fc_bc u_sk0 -> skid3r registered N boundary (k0_d / k0_mv / ready from flops) with its head FIRM at the N end of the centre channel (cal3 TT -205: skid output mux 397 ps of wire from the N pins; class 3/4), S face unanchored. Cycle-identical; exactness gated at the front_c parent. [hbm-smh/fc] front_c OT_SMH_FC_HIER (textbook audit class 1: one 54k-sink tree over 570 x 518 + the 2,069-bit x-write ~1,000 um from N face to the bottom band): hardened sub-element fc_bc of front_c 898.56 x 1088.64 (physical spec el1011-hbm-smh.log [hbm-smh/fc]); M2-M6 power M6, pin flops anchored, pass stages spread; Round 5: reset relay replicated per consumer in fc_is / fc_bc (class 2: fc_is TT -657 = one relay flop async-clear net); fc_bc not pin-anchored (24-um S strip ran into the ring-macro halo: DPL-0004 off-row FIRM flops); fo_row0 first on the N face + fc_xl u_m0 in the NW corner (TT -95.8 output port); fc_b / fc_xr input-landing hold near-misses (-35 / -22 ps, li pin flops) -> LOCAL addition --hold-buffer-pct 45. Round 4: fc_bc DPL-0033 / fc_xr GPL-0305 -> GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0 DONT_BUFFER_PORTS=1 ENABLE_DPO=0 (FIRM pin-flop class, route_tile_xl.sh); fc_t RSZ-0060 = 4,287 internal zero-logic pass-pair hold endpoints (u_p2d, u_m1; WNS -34 incl. margin, IO budget calibrated 276) -> LOCAL addition --hold-buffer-pct 45. Round 3: no --io-ref (CTS SIGSEGV); IO budget from the calibrated insertion (CK_SS_MEAN / CK_FF_MEAN), calibrate with SKIP_CTS_REPAIR_TIMING=1. Pin-flop anchoring (24-um strips) only on fc_bc / fc_is / fc_t (their N/S pin spans clear the W/E strips); fc_xl / fc_xr / fc_b unanchored (stages already separated by opposite-face pins). Earlier: pin-flop strips 12 um (12 um: no room for 1,085-2,887 flops at 0.096-um pins), GPL_TIMING_DRIVEN=0 (OpenROAD SIGSEGV in timing-driven 3_3_place_gp under the IO reference, as on front_c ntd).
